capabilities: Runs a real PTY-backed shell with multiple concurrent terminals
Tracks Claude Code edits and shows word-level, line-numbered diffs
Accepts or rejects changes per file or per hunk, with undo
Explains failed commands and suggests fixes through Claude
Organises Claude sessions into groups with an agent inbox
extras: macOS and Linux only; Windows is not supported. Session logging to notes and agent control are off by default. If Claude Code's Keychain login can't be read, a token from claude setup-token can be pasted in settings.
motivation: Built so a Claude Code turn never leaves you hunting for where a change happened or copying errors into a separate chat window.
problem: Obsidian has no terminal, and Claude Code's file edits land on disk with no in-app way to see, review or revert them.

relations.evidence: The plugin auto-provisions a project-scoped .claude/settings.local.json in your vault wiring a PreToolUse hook
Vault Publisher offers its site preview this way, so its Open in Terminus button
git is optional. It powers the "vs git HEAD" diff view

requires.name: Claude Code CLI (claude), installed and logged in

summary: PTY-backed terminal inside Obsidian with shell integration, command-failure help, and a Claude Code review workflow with per-file diffs.
